finding.title: Inject intel summary into tp-help context package
finding.evidence: GAP:missing-trigger. intelligence.md states /tp-help should use callers/callees/similar to enrich the context package, but the tp-help command does not mandate this step before delegating to dual-invoke.sh.
finding.impact: Reviewers start cold on tp-help requests, missing critical dependency context.
finding.required_plan_update: Update `.claude/commands/tp-help.md` (and its backing SKILL.md) to automatically run `scripts/intel-query.sh callers <symbol>` and append the output to the context package sent to the reviewers.

finding.title: Improve intel-query.sh UX with --human default and --help
finding.evidence: BLOAT:json-as-default. Default output is JSON, requiring opt-in `--human`, and the script rejects `--help`. This is hostile for human CLI exploration.
finding.impact: Users abandon the tool when exploring from the terminal due to opaque JSON walls and lacking standard --help conventions.
finding.required_plan_update: Modify flag parsing: if `[ -t 1 ]` (stdout is a tty), default to `--human`. Add explicit `--help|-h` trap to print usage and exit 0, bypassing the query_graph.py help error.

finding.title: Enhance graph output shapes for reviewer ingestion
finding.evidence: BLOAT:json-as-default. The current JSON/raw output formats aren't optimal for pasting into plan sections or reviewer envelopes. Determining blast-radius requires three separate sequential commands.
finding.impact: Agents spend extra turns formatting output and running multiple queries to piece together context.
finding.required_plan_update: Add `--format md` to generate markdown tables. Add a `blast-radius <symbol>` composite query that runs callers, callees, and similar in one invocation. Add ASCII call-tree formatting for callers/callees in human mode.

finding.title: Auto-inject intel summaries via pre-review hook
finding.evidence: GAP:discoverability. Reviewers currently rely on explicitly defined prompts to gather context. A hook could pre-compute the intel summary so it's already in the prompt context.
finding.impact: Missed opportunities to provide ambient, zero-cost context to reviewers on every relevant command invocation.
finding.required_plan_update: Create `.claude/hooks/pre-review-intel.sh` that triggers on relevant slash-commands (like review-work), pre-runs `scripts/intel-query.sh --human file-symbols <diff paths>`, and injects the output into the prompt.
